lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Enclave 7, 2312. Fourth floor of the Allocation Office, twenty-three forty. Everyone else signed out at six, because the Steward allocates rest and the Steward is not cruel about it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Eleven years I have closed this quarter in an afternoon. You reconcile what was allocated against what was drawn, you find the rounding, you sign it, you go home.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Tonight it will not close. And the amount by which it will not close is about the same amount it did not close by last quarter, which is not how rounding behaves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The monitor array is on the desk with the audit shell still open. The window looks out over the housing blocks. Against the wall by the lift there is a bench, and a filing cabinet that holds the paper copies.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The corridor door is shut, which is how doors are here.
